nodes.label: Apliquefy Platform
nodes.rationale: Job-application automation platform: user configures parameters (resume, filters, daily limits) on the web panel; a local desktop agent runs applications on LinkedIn and InfoJobs in real time while the machine is on. The two environments communicate via REST API and a Clerk-based session.

nodes.label: Desktop Authentication Flow
nodes.rationale: Desktop opens a Clerk /login popup BrowserWindow with redirect_url=/desktop-auth/success; after login it detects the redirect via did-navigate, fetches the token via /api/desktop-auth/session (cookie exchange) and closes the window.

nodes.label: Credits System
nodes.rationale: Each application consumes credits per CreditWeight.stage; plans grant monthly credits via Stripe webhook customer.subscription.updated; one-off Checkout purchases credit instantly; failed applications auto-refund.

nodes.label: Service-Controller Pattern (Zod boundary)
nodes.rationale: Strict separation between transport (Controllers) and business logic (Services). Each backend module follows Zod schema -> Controller -> Service. Zod validates at every external boundary; the AI generates the boilerplate 'casca' while the developer implements the business/RPA 'alma'.

nodes.label: Prisma Data Models
nodes.rationale: Core models: User, Resume (JSONB), Campaign, CampaignLinkedin/CampaignInfojobs (1:1), Job, JobApplication, Report, Transaction, CreditWeight, WebhookEvent (Stripe idempotency).

nodes.label: Backend Development Contract (casca)
nodes.rationale: AI-as-senior-engineer contract: always start with a complete Zod schema, generate a fully functional Controller, but deliver Services as empty shells (signature + JSDoc only). Never implement RPA/Playwright logic, never mix DB/automation into Controllers, never invent env-var values. Preserves the developer's technical ownership of business logic while accelerating boilerplate.

nodes.label: Frontend/Backend/Electron Output Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Strict casca/alma split: AI owns boilerplate, UI, types, validation; developer owns business rules, RPA logic and complex global state. UI components must be stateless (props-only, no useState/useEffect); Electron work focuses on preload + window.electronAPI typing, leaving main-process handlers to the developer.

nodes.label: Hyper-Direct Playwright Engineer Behavior
nodes.rationale: Communication style spec for a Playwright automation specialist: 3-6 word phrases, zero preamble, execute tools first then show result and stop, no step narration, omit articles.

nodes.label: Apliquefy Visual Cognitive Agent
nodes.rationale: RPA cognitive engine: receives an annotated screenshot + JSON (resume, campaign, numbered interactive elements) and returns ONE JSON action per turn (status_code/acao/elemento_id/texto_resposta). Strict fidelity (no hallucination), one action targeting the first empty visible field, conservative choices on borderline cases; status codes 200/201/400/403/404/422/500 map to preencher/selecionar/clicar/upload/concluir/pausar.
